summary: Server one-frame event on a lock (door/chest) that was just unlocked. Written by esv::lock::LockSystem::FinalizeLockRequests (macOS index; bg3.exe helper 0x2D45320 called from 0x2D45B50). Seen.py context: locked:<chest/door> situations (unlocking with a key or by script).

fields.name: Key
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2D475D0 allocates 8 bytes, default null handle. bg3.exe+0x2D45320 takes a variant (index 0 = FixedString key id, index 1 = EntityHandle); the handle local starts as 0xffc0000000000000 and only for variant 1 is set to the variant's entity (the key item); after a successful unlock it calls 0x2D475D0 on the lock entity and writes that handle. Live (2 instances): one null, one valid handle - matches unlocking by key name vs key item.

open_questions: Variant index 1 assumed to be the key item; could be the unlocking character.
